why: arXiv:2404.06271 'On Goncharov's conjecture in next to Milnor degree' (Bolbachan, posted April 2024, revised Oct 2025) proves the conjecture in the case of motivic cohomology in degree m-1 and weight m, matching the stated problem's own object (cohomology of Goncharov's motivic complex).
